info.name: IAM System OPEN Audit Log API

params.name: pageToken
params.description: The pagination token received from a previous [List audit logs](#tag/Audit-Log/paths/~1auditLogs/get) request. Use this token to retrieve the next page of results.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: The maximum number of audit logs to return. If not specified, at most 100 audit logs will be returned.

params.name: startTime
params.description: Filters the results to include only audit logs created on or after this timestamp, in the [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

params.name: endTime
params.description: Filters the results to include only audit logs created before or at this timestamp, in the [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

params.name: auditEventTypes
params.description: Filters the results by specific event types. For more information, see [Console audit event types](https://docs.pingcap.com/tidbcloud/tidb-cloud-console-auditing/#console-audit-event-types).

params.name: keyword
params.description: Filters results to include only audit logs that contain the specified search term.

items.docs: Lists all console audit logs for your organization. This endpoint helps you track various behaviors and operations of users on the [TiDB Cloud console](https://tidbcloud.com/). You can filter results by time range, event type, or keyword.
